crossRefs.note: “Let them announce and declare to us what will happen! Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider…
Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show…
Who is like me? Who will call, and will declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people?…
Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it…
“What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies…
Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we…

translations.web: Who has declared it from the beginning, that we may know? and before, that we may say, ‘He is right?’ Surely, there is no one who declares. Surely, there is no one who shows. Surely, there is no one who hears your words.
translations.bsb: Who has declared this from the beginning, so that we may know, and from times past, so that we may say: ‘He was right’? No one announced it, no one foretold it, no one heard your words.
translations.kjv: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.
translations.asv: Who hath declared it from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is right? yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that showeth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.
